description: This file manages WebSocket connection authentication context, including resolving authentication states and decisions based on tokens, proxies, and rate limiting.

methods.name: resolveConnectAuthState
methods.description: Resolves the current authentication state based on provided parameters, including tokens, proxies, and rate limiting.

methods.name: resolveConnectAuthDecision
methods.description: Determines the final authentication decision by verifying bootstrap or device tokens and applying rate limiting.
